recognize_zh: 中倍下可見淡紫紅色、呈條紋狀流動的無定形基質，其中散布稀疏的小型有核細胞與紅血球，並有數個圓形脂肪空泡，細胞量明顯減少，符合骨髓膠狀轉化。
features: Streaming, pale magenta amorphous extracellular matrix with a faintly fibrillar, wispy texture
Sparse, scattered small nucleated cells embedded in the matrix
Red cells distributed throughout, partly outlined by the ground substance
Several round clear vacuoles consistent with fat droplets
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at intermediate power shows abundant pale magenta, amorphous ground substance with a streaming fibrillar appearance. Nucleated marrow cells are sparse and scattered individually within the matrix, accompanied by red cells and occasional small fat vacuoles. No cohesive abnormal cell clusters are identified. Findings are consistent with gelatinous transformation of the marrow, compatible with the clinical history of anorexia nervosa.

ddx.vs: Amyloid is dense, waxy and Congo red positive, while gelatinous transformation material is loose, mucoid and Alcian blue positive (hyaluronic acid).
A dilute aspirate shows blood without the thick extracellular magenta ground substance.
Necrosis shows smudged, degenerating cells with loss of nuclear detail rather than intact cells in a mucoid matrix.
